newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt paper firm H1 96/7 profits lower.
newsitem.headline: Egypt paper firm H1 96/7 profits lower.

text.p: Rakta/General Paper Industry said on Thursday its net pre-tax profits for the first six months of the 1996/7 financial year plummeted to 7.43 million pounds ($2.19 million) from 40.22 million in the same period of the previous year.
The financial year begins on July 1.
The firm said in a published advertisement that net sales had fallen to 70.58 million from 119.16 million in the first half of financial 1995/6.

The company said in November it made net after-tax profits of 36.82 million pounds ($10.83 million) in 1995/6, against 34.43 million in the previous year. It also gave out a 1.10 pound dividend for each of its 10.868 million shares.
